name: email-tool
description: IMAP/SMTP email: read, search, draft and send mail. One MCP server for all your mailboxes; passwords in the OS keyring.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search, draft and send email from your own mailboxes
interface.longDescription: Runs on your machine. Add each mailbox once in a terminal with `email-tool-mcp add <name>`; passwords stay in the OS keyring and never leave your computer except to your mail server.
